stories.headline: S&P 500 falls for eighth time in nine sessions as AI rebound fades
stories.summary: U.S. stocks gave back part of Monday's sharp gain on Tuesday, a day after the market posted its best session since April 2025. The S&P 500 fell 0.5% to 7,201 and the Nasdaq Composite fell 1.48% to 23,734 as technology shares led losses. Anthropic shares also fell back below their IPO price.

stories.headline: AMD falls 9% after filing to register 337 million shares for resale
stories.summary: Advanced Micro Devices shares fell 8.86% to $413.27 on Tuesday on volume about 64% above the three-month average. After Monday's close the company filed an automatic shelf registration covering about 336.9 million shares for resale by existing holders. That includes 160 million shares under an OpenAI warrant and 160 million under a Meta warrant, which raised concerns about future supply of the stock.

stories.headline: Dow closes above 50,000 for first time as investors move into healthcare and consumer stocks
stories.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.9% to 50,018.70 on Tuesday, its first close above 50,000, while the Nasdaq fell. Money moved out of chip stocks and into healthcare, retail and consumer names. Amgen, Merck, Vertex, Regeneron, Nike and Target each rose about 5%, and small caps ended higher.

stories.headline: Micron falls 11% on concern over high-bandwidth memory demand
stories.summary: Micron Technology shares fell 11.01% on Tuesday, giving back more than two-thirds of Monday's gain. The drop came on concern that demand for high-bandwidth memory used in AI chips could slow. Every stock in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index closed lower.

stories.headline: Chip stocks fall as investors test Nvidia-led rally
stories.summary: U.S. stocks fell on Tuesday as chip shares gave back part of Monday's gains. Nvidia was down about 6% to 8%, AMD fell between 8% and 12%, and Micron and Broadcom also declined. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was down about 8.5% in early trading. Renewed congressional scrutiny of Nvidia and questions about returns on AI spending and interest rates weighed on the sector.

stories.headline: Futures price December Fed hike as Treasury yields ease below 5%
stories.summary: Fed funds futures moved on Monday to price in a December rate hike, and the dollar firmed. The 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.9% on Tuesday, down from above 5.1% a week earlier, after New York Fed President John Williams warned about inflation. In our data, high-yield spreads widened by about 0.4 percentage points over the week to 3.76.
